        if not isinstance(member['path'], str):

        if member['path'].startswith('/') or '\\' in member['path']:
            return False
        parts = member['path'].split('/')
        for part in parts:
            if part == '' or part == '.' or part == '..':
                return False
        
        if not isinstance(member['content_b64'], str):
            return False
        try:
            content = base64.b64decode(member['content_b64'])
        except Exception:
            return False
        if len(content) > 64 * 1024:
            return False
        
        if not isinstance(member['mode'], int) or isinstance(member['mode'], bool):
            return False
        if member['mode'] < 0 or member['mode'] > 511:

    if not isinstance(data['timestamp'], list):
        return False
    if len(data['timestamp']) != 6:

    for val in data['timestamp']:
        if not isinstance(val, int) or isinstance(val, bool):
            return False
    
    year, month, day, hour, minute, second = data['timestamp']
    if year < 1980 or year > 2107:
        return False
    if month < 1 or month > 12:
        return False
    if day < 1:
        return False
    if month in (1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12):
        if day > 31:

    elif month in (4, 6, 9, 11):
        if day > 30:
            return False
    elif month == 2:
        is_leap = (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0)
        if day > (29 if is_leap else 28):
            return False
    if hour < 0 or hour > 23:
        return False
    if minute < 0 or minute > 59:
        return False
    if second < 0 or second > 59:
        return False
    if second % 2 != 0:
        return False
    
    if not isinstance(data['comment'], str):
        return False
    if len(data['comment']) > 200:

    }))
